blocks.text: Jab thori si mukhtalif frequencies wali do waves ek hi simt mein chalte hue ek doosre par aati (overlap) hain, to awaz baar baar oonchi aur dheemi hoti hai (zyada se zyada aur kam se kam loudness ke darmiyan periodic tabdeeli). Isi ko beats kehte hain.

Tuning forks khalis (pure) notes dete hain, yani sirf ek frequency. Agar ek jaisi frequency (maslan 32 Hz) ke do tuning forks A aur B alag alag bajaye jayein to dono khalis note dete hain. Agar dono ek saath bajayein to ek ka note doosre se alag pehchanna mushkil hota hai; dono ki sound waves superpose ho kar insani kaan ko ek hi khalis note sunai deti hain.

Agar fork B par thora sa wax (mom) ya plasticine laga diya jaye to us ki frequency thori kam ho jati hai, maslan 28 Hz. Ab dono forks ek saath bajayein to aisa note sunai deta hai jis ki intensity (shiddat) baari baari barhti aur ghatti hai. Is note ko beat note ya beat kehte hain; yeh forks A aur B ki sound waves ke interference se banta hai.

Fig. 7.12 (a) fork A ke note ka waveform aur Fig. 7.12 (b) fork B ke note ka waveform dikhati hai. Jab dono forks ek saath bajte hain to resultant waveform Fig. 7.12 (c) mein hai; yeh batata hai ke beat note kaise banta hai. Kisi lamhe X par dono waves ka displacement ek hi simt mein hai, is liye resultant displacement bara hai aur oonchi awaz sunai deti hai.

blocks.alt: Waqt ke sath teen lehrein oopar neeche. (a) fork A ki lehar, (b) fork B ki thori lambi lehar, (c) dono ka nateeja, jis ka size dashed ghere ke andar barhta ghatta hai. Teeno par dashed lakeeren X (oonchi), Y (dheemi) aur Z (oonchi); X se Y aur Y se Z 1/8 s, aur X se Z 1/4 s. Resultant wave likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.12: Beats ka banna (kitab ki Figure 7.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: A ki frequency 32 Hz aur B ki 28 Hz hai. X par dono ke crest ek saath: oonchi awaz. 1/8 s baad (Y) A, B se aadha chakkar aage nikal jata hai, to dono ek doosre ko khatam karti hain: dheemi awaz. 1/4 s par (Z) phir oonchi. Yani har 1/4 s mein ek beat, ek second mein 4 beats = 32 − 28.
1/8 s baad ek fork ki wave ka displacement doosre fork ki wave ke ulat hota hai, is liye Y par displacement kam se kam hota hai aur dheemi awaz ya koi awaz nahi sunai deti.
Mazeed 1/8 s baad displacements phir ek hi simt mein hote hain aur Z par phir oonchi awaz sunai deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka text Y ko X se '1/4 s baad' aur Z ko Y se 'mazeed 1/4 s baad' likhta hai. 4 beats fi second ke saath ek buland awaz se agli tak 1/4 s hai, is liye buland se dheemi (X se Y) 1/8 s aur dheemi se buland (Y se Z) mazeed 1/8 s hai, jaisa kitab ki apni Fig. 7.12 bhi dikhati hai.
Dono forks ki frequencies ka farq bhi 4 Hz hai, yani ek second mein beats ki tadaad dono tuning forks ki frequencies ke farq ke barabar hai:

blocks.text_alt: f_A = 32 Hz,  f_B = 28 Hz,   f_A > f_B
Beats ki tadaad = f_A − f_B = 32 Hz − 28 Hz = 4

blocks.text: Lekin jab do awazon ki frequencies ka farq 10 Hz se zyada ho to beats pehchanna mushkil ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Awaz longitudinal hai: hawa ki tehein lehar ki simt mein aage peeche hilti hain, is liye compression aur rarefaction bante hain. Roshni transverse hai: crest aur trough. Kitab longitudinal lehar ka Amplitude khara (vertical) teer bana kar dikhati hai; asal mein tehein lehar ki simt mein hilti hain, is liye yahan Amplitude ko lehar ki simt mein chhote do-teer se dikhaya gaya hai.

Beats se piano ya violin jaise string (taar wale) saaz tune kiye ja sakte hain: saaz ka note kisi maloom frequency ke note ke saath bajayein. Phir string ko kas kar ya dheela kar ke tab tak theek karein jab tak beats sunai dena band na ho jayein; tab dono frequencies barabar hoti hain.
Beat Frequency (f_beat)
Do waves ki frequencies ke farq ko beat frequency f_beat kehte hain. Do lagataar oonchi awazon ke darmiyan waqt ka waqfa T = t₂ − t₁ ho to:
Musical instruments ki tuning
Musical instruments mein beats kaise bante hain, is ki kuch misalein:

items: Guitar: thori mukhtalif tuning wali do strings bajane se beats bante hain, maslan ek standard tune ki hui string aur ek string jo chand cents (bohat thora) oonchi ya neechi tune ho.
Piano: saath saath wali do keys, safed aur kaali, bajane se beats bante hain.
Violin: do strings ko bow (gaz) ke thore mukhtalif dabao ya raftar se bajane par beats bante hain.
Drums: thori mukhtalif tuning wale do drums ek saath bajane se beats bante hain.
Flute: honton aur chehre ke muscles ki thori mukhtalif position (embouchure) se do notes bajane par beats bante hain.
Organ: thori mukhtalif tuning wale do pipes bajane se beats bante hain.
Synthesizer: thori mukhtalif frequencies wale do oscillators chalane se beats bante hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Zyada tar string (taar wale) aur wind (hawa wale) musical instruments ki awaz un ke andar stationary (standing) waves banne se paida hoti hai.
In sab misalon mein do sound sources ki frequency ka thora sa farq amplitude ko baar baar barhata aur ghatata hai, jis se "beat" ya dhadkan (pulsation) jaisa asar banta hai.

Musicians aksar jaan boojh kar beats istemal karte hain taake dilchasp rhythm, awaz mein texture (gehraai), ya tanao aur sukoon ka ehsas paida ho. Lekin kabhi beats na-pasandeeda hote hain, aur un ka asar kam karne ke liye tuning, pitch ya bajane ke tareeqe mein tabdeeli karni parti hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.7
blocks.problem: Do tuning forks 3 Hz beat frequency ke beats dete hain. Ek fork ki frequency 256 Hz hai. Phir us fork ke ek prong (daante) par thora wax laga kar us ki frequency thori kam ki jati hai, aur ab dono forks 1 Hz beat frequency dete hain. Doosre tuning fork ki frequency nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: pehle fork ki frequency f₁ = 256 Hz; wax se pehle beat frequency = 3 Hz; wax ke baad = 1 Hz; doosre fork ki frequency f₂ = ?
Beats ki tadaad n = frequencies ka farq: f₁ − f₂ = ±n, yani f₂ = f₁ ± n.
f₂ = 256 ± 3, yani f₂ = 259 Hz ya 253 Hz.
Agar f₂ = 259 Hz hota: wax se pehle fork ki frequency 256 se neeche (255, 254 Hz) jati, to farq 3 se barh jata (4, 5 beats). Lekin beats kam ho kar 1 hue, is liye 259 Hz sahi nahi.
Agar f₂ = 253 Hz ho: wax ke baad pehla fork 254 Hz ho jata hai, aur 254 − 253 = 1 Hz, jo sawal se milta hai.
blocks.answer: Doosre fork ki sahi frequency f₂ = 253 Hz hai.

blocks.prompt: Tuning fork A fork B ke saath fi second 4 beats paida karta hai; B par mom lagane se beat frequency 6 ho jati hai. Agar A 320 Hz ho to mom lage B ki frequency nikalein (numerical 7.3). Frequency ka farq 10 Hz se zyada hone par beats pehchanna mushkil kyun hai (constructed response 7.5)?
blocks.explanation: B = 320 ± 4 = 324 Hz ya 316 Hz. Wax B ki frequency kam karta hai; beats 4 se barh kar 6 sirf tab hote hain jab B pehle hi A se neeche ho, to B = 316 Hz aur wax lage B ki frequency = 320 − 6 = 314 Hz. Agar farq 10 Hz se zyada ho to ek second mein 10 se zyada baar awaz oonchi neechi hoti hai; kaan itni tezi se is utaar charhao ko alag alag nahi sun pata, aur beats dhadkan ki bajaye ek khurdari awaz ban jate hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Beats: ek simt mein chalti, thori mukhtalif frequency wali do waves se awaz baar baar oonchi aur dheemi hoti hai.
Ek second mein beats = f_A − f_B (32 − 28 = 4); f_beat = 1/T; 10 Hz se zyada farq par beats pehchanna mushkil.
Beats se saaz tune kiye jate hain; guitar, piano, violin, drums, flute, organ, synthesizer mein beats bante hain.
Example 7.7: doosra fork 253 Hz (259 Hz se beats barhte, kam nahi hote).
